creator: tenminutetable
title: Croque Monsieur
description: A cheese sandwich with a sauce on top, which sounds like too much and is exactly enough.
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, and cook for a minute.
Whisk in the milk and cook to a thick bechamel, then add mustard and nutmeg.
Butter the bread on the outside, build the sandwiches with ham and half the cheese.
Fry them in a dry pan for 3 minutes a side until deep gold.
Spoon the bechamel over the tops and cover with the rest of the cheese.
Grill until blistered and bubbling, about 3 minutes.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Caprese Salad
description: Three ingredients, so all three have to be good. Room temperature, not fridge cold.
steps: Slice the tomatoes thick and lay them on a plate.
Salt them and leave for 5 minutes so they start to weep.
Tear the mozzarella over rather than slicing it, so it holds the oil.
Scatter the basil leaves whole.
Pour olive oil over everything and finish with flaky salt.
Serve at room temperature; cold mozzarella tastes of nothing.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Avocado Toast
description: Toast it harder than feels right. Soft bread under wet avocado is the whole failure mode.
steps: Toast the sourdough hard, so it stays crisp under the topping.
Rub the hot toast with a cut clove of garlic if you have one.
Mash the avocado roughly with the lemon and salt; leave it lumpy.
Pile it on thick rather than spreading it thin.
Finish with olive oil, chilli flakes and more salt.
Eat immediately, while the toast is still crisp underneath.

creator: tenminutetable
title: French Omelette
description: Medium-low, and off the heat while the middle still looks underdone. Browning it is the only real mistake.
steps: Beat the eggs until completely uniform, with no streaks of white left.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat until it foams but does not colour.
Pour in the eggs and stir constantly with a spatula for 20 seconds.
Stop stirring and let the base set for 15 seconds while the top stays glossy.
Tilt the pan and roll the omelette over on itself towards the handle.
Turn it out seam down; it should be pale yellow with no browning anywhere.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Bruschetta al Pomodoro
description: Drain the tomatoes and rub the garlic on hot bread. Both take a minute and both matter.
steps: Dice the tomatoes, salt them, and leave them in a sieve for 10 minutes to drain.
Grill or griddle the bread until it has dark bars on both sides.
Rub the hot bread firmly with the cut garlic; the toast grates it away.
Pour olive oil over the bread and let it soak in.
Spoon the drained tomatoes on and tear the basil over.
Assemble at the last second or the bread goes soft.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Caesar Salad
description: The dressing is a mayonnaise. Add the oil slowly or it will split and there is no rescuing it in a salad bowl.
steps: Fry the bread cubes in oil until crisp all over and drain them on paper.
Mash the anchovies and garlic to a paste with a little salt.
Whisk in the yolk, mustard and lemon juice.
Add the oil drop by drop at first, then in a thin stream, until it thickens.
Toss the lettuce through the dressing so every leaf is coated but not drowned.
Add the croutons and parmesan and toss once more.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Club Sandwich
description: Sticks in before the knife, not after. Three layers will not hold otherwise.
steps: Fry the bacon until properly crisp and drain it.
Toast all six slices and spread mayonnaise on one side of each.
Build the first layer: chicken, lettuce, then a slice of toast mayonnaise up.
Build the second: bacon, tomato, lettuce, then the last slice.
Push a cocktail stick through each quarter before you cut it.
Cut corner to corner twice, into four triangles.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Egg Salad Sandwich
description: Nine minutes and straight into ice. Overcooked yolks go grey and chalky and the whole thing turns dry.
steps: Lower the eggs into already boiling water and cook for 9 minutes.
Move them straight into iced water and leave until completely cold.
Peel and chop them roughly; some pieces should stay large.
Fold through the mayonnaise, mustard and chives.
Season hard with salt and white pepper — egg takes more than you think.
Pile onto soft bread, not toast.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Tzatziki
description: Wring the cucumber out properly. Skip it and you get soup within the hour.
steps: Grate the cucumber, salt it, and leave it in a sieve for 15 minutes.
Squeeze it out hard in a cloth; you want it almost dry.
Beat the garlic into the yoghurt with the vinegar.
Fold in the cucumber and dill.
Pour the olive oil over the top rather than stirring it in.
Rest it in the fridge for 30 minutes before serving.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Smoked Salmon Bagel
description: Fold the salmon rather than flattening it. It is the difference between a plate and a sandwich.
steps: Toast the bagel halves lightly, just enough to warm them.
Spread the cream cheese thickly on the bottom halves.
Drape the salmon over in loose folds rather than laying it flat.
Scatter the red onion, capers and dill.
Squeeze lemon over and grind black pepper on.
Leave the top half off and eat it open.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Bircher Muesli
description: Grate the apple in the morning, not the night before. Overnight it goes brown and tastes tired.
steps: Stir the oats into the apple juice and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, grate the apple straight into the bowl, skin and all.
Toss it with the lemon juice immediately so it does not brown.
Fold in the yoghurt and honey.
Loosen with a splash more juice if it has set too thick.
Top with the toasted hazelnuts just before eating so they stay crisp.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Honey Granola
description: Press it down and do not stir it. Every stir breaks the clusters you are trying to make.
steps: Mix the oats, nuts, seeds, cinnamon and salt in a large bowl.
Warm the honey and coconut oil together until pourable and stir them through.
Spread it on a lined tray and press it down firmly with the back of a spoon.
Bake at 300F for 25 minutes, turning the tray once but not stirring.
Leave it to cool completely on the tray without touching it; that is how the clusters form.
Break it up and fold in the dried cherries.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
description: Garlic into cold oil, and pasta water is the sauce. Brown garlic is bitter and there is no fixing it.
steps: Boil the pasta in heavily salted water and set a mug of the water aside before draining.
Start the garlic in cold oil over low heat so it toasts slowly rather than burning.
When it is pale gold — not brown — add the chilli flakes and take it off the heat.
Drain the pasta a minute early and add it to the pan with a splash of the water.
Toss hard over the heat until the oil and water emulsify and cling.
Add parsley and one more splash if it looks tight.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Tortilla Española
description: Poached in oil, not fried, and still a little loose in the middle. Cooked through it is just a potato cake.
steps: Cook the potato and onion gently in the oil for 20 minutes; they should soften, not fry.
Drain them well, keeping a spoonful of the oil.
Beat the eggs hard, season, then fold the warm potatoes in and rest 10 minutes.
Cook in the reserved oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until the edges set.
Slide it onto a plate, invert the pan over it, and flip the whole thing back.
Cook 4 minutes more; the middle should still be slightly loose.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Pico de Gallo
description: Rinse the onion and pour off the water. Both take seconds and stop it tasting harsh and watery.
steps: Dice everything to the same size; it should sit evenly on a chip.
Rinse the diced onion under cold water for 30 seconds to take the raw bite off.
Toss the tomato, onion and jalapeno with the salt.
Leave it for 10 minutes, then pour off the liquid that collects.
Stir in the lime juice and coriander at the last moment.
Serve within the hour; it does not keep.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Loaded Nachos
description: Two thin layers, not one deep pile. Cold toppings go on after the oven, never before.
steps: Spread half the chips in a single layer on a tray, not a pile.
Scatter half the beans, cumin and cheese over them.
Repeat with the rest of the chips, beans and cheese.
Bake at 400F for 10 minutes until the cheese has fully melted.
Add the cold toppings — avocado, sour cream, spring onion — only after it comes out.
Eat straight off the tray.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Deviled Eggs
description: Push the yolks through a sieve. It is the only way the filling goes properly smooth.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes and cool them completely in iced water.
Peel, halve lengthways, and lift the yolks into a sieve.
Push the yolks through the sieve so there are no lumps at all.
Beat in the mayonnaise, mustard and vinegar until smooth and glossy.
Pipe or spoon the filling back into the whites, mounded high.
Dust with paprika and scatter the chives.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Strawberry Milkshake
description: Fruit first, ice cream second, and pulse. Blend it all at once and you get pink milk.
steps: Hull the strawberries and freeze them for 20 minutes if they are very ripe.
Blend the strawberries with the milk first, until completely smooth.
Add the ice cream and pulse briefly — long blending melts it and thins the shake.
Taste and add honey only if the fruit needs it.
Pour into chilled glasses.
Drink immediately.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Green Smoothie
description: Greens and liquid first, on their own. Everything at once leaves you chewing spinach.
steps: Blend the spinach with the coconut water first, on its own, until no flecks remain.
Add the apple and ginger and blend again.
Add the frozen banana last and blend until thick.
The frozen banana is what makes it cold and thick without ice watering it down.
Sharpen with lime juice to taste.
Pour and drink straight away, before it separates.

creator: tenminutetable
title: Affogato
description: Hot coffee, cold ice cream, poured at the table. Everything about it is the temperature difference.
steps: Chill the serving glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Put two scoops of ice cream into each glass.
Pull the espresso and use it immediately, while it is still properly hot.
Pour it over the ice cream at the table, not in the kitchen.
Scatter the hazelnuts over.
Eat it while half of it is still frozen.
